terbaru.judul: DEPLOYERS: An agent based modeling tool for multi country real world data

terbaru.judul: Simulation of Social Media-Driven Bubble Formation in Financial Markets using an Agent-Based Model with Hierarchical Influence Network
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose that a tree-like hierarchical structure represents a simple and effective way to model the emergent behaviour of financial markets, especially markets where there exists a pronounced intersection between social media influences and investor behaviour.

terbaru.judul: Modelling Opaque Bilateral Market Dynamics in Financial Trading: Insights from a Multi-Agent Simulation Study
terbaru.pelajaran: Exploring complex adaptive financial trading environments through multi-agent based simulation methods presents an innovative approach within the realm of quantitative finance.

terbaru.judul: Scalable Agent-Based Modeling for Complex Financial Market Simulations
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a baseline model implementation and show that it captures several known statistical properties of real financial markets (i.e., stylized facts).

terbaru.judul: Adaptive Agents and Data Quality in Agent-Based Financial Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We present our Agent-Based Market Microstructure Simulation (ABMMS), an Agent-Based Financial Market (ABFM) that captures much of the complexity present in the US National Market System for equities (NMS).

terbaru.judul: Tasks Makyth Models: Machine Learning Assisted Surrogates for Tipping Points
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a machine learning (ML)-assisted framework bridging manifold learning, neural networks, Gaussian processes, and Equation-Free multiscale modeling, for (a) detecting tipping points in the emergent behavior of complex systems, and (b) characterizing probabilities of rare events (here, catastrophic shifts) near them.

terbaru.judul: Comparing effects of price limit and circuit breaker in stock exchanges by an agent-based model
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, we examine this question using an artificial market model that is an agent-based model for a financial market.

This paper explains the two regularities simply in terms of traders' attitudes towards news, an explanation that follows almost by definition of the traditional dichotomy of financial market participants, investors versus speculators, whose behaviors are reduced to their simplest forms.

terbaru.judul: Agent-Based Modelling for Real-World Stock Markets under Behavioral Economic Principles
terbaru.pelajaran: The reproduction of realistic dynamics in financial markets is of great significance, as it enhances our understanding of market evolution beyond other physical processes, and facilitates the development and backtesting of investment strategies.

terbaru.judul: Many learning agents interacting with an agent-based market model
terbaru.pelajaran: We find that the inclusion of optimal execution agents changes the stylised facts produced by ABM to conform more with empirical data, and are a necessary inclusion for ABMs investigating market micro-structure.
